title: Eisenhower Timeline
text: For the Eisenhower Memorial Commission’s digital history experience, I worked on JavaScript development and the CMS frontend. An interactive timeline using Canvas connected events in Dwight D. Eisenhower’s life with national and world history. Historical photographs and video accompanied the material, while related lesson plans helped teachers use it in the classroom. The visual timeline gave visitors an overview of the collection organized by time. It was one part of a wider educational experience about Eisenhower’s military service, presidency, and the decisions that shaped both.
summary: I contributed JavaScript and CMS frontend development to an interactive Eisenhower history experience, connecting a visual timeline with archival material and resources for educators.
